Subject: FinBank - evals discovery & next steps

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have alignment on scope and what we need to run a customer-specific eval on Redwood: 

1) Goals / success criteria (from discovery)
- Evaluate model fit for customer-facing Q&A and KYC extraction workflows
- Maintain high precision on PII extraction, target FDR < 2% on flagged fields
- Latency target: 150–250ms p50 for shorter prompts; throughput targets for batch inference noted in CRM (HS-123456789)

2) Recommended models to test (initial shortlist)
- redwood-7b-q4f32 (fast, cost-efficient baseline)
- redwood-13b-int8 (better factuality & instruction-following for complex prompts)
- fallbacks: redwood-7b-8k and a comparator open model (meta-mpt-7b) for cost/quality tradeoffs

3) Eval plan / dataset format (what we need from you)
- CSV with columns: id,input_text,expected_response,labels (if applicable). Please include up to 2k representative examples to start; we can scale later.
- Include a small dev set (100–200) for prompt tuning and a holdout test set (500–1000) for final scores.
- If you have ontology mappings for entity extraction, include a README with label definitions.

4) Scoring criteria / metrics we’ll run
- Exact-match / token-level accuracy for extraction tasks
- Semantic similarity (SBERT-based) + thresholding for tolerant QA scoring; report avg similarity and % above threshold (we typically use 0.85 as a starting point)
- Precision/recall/F1 for entity extraction and PII detection
- Regression checks against your baseline (if provided) — we’ll flag any category with >5% drop in F1

5) Security / deployment notes
- We can run evals on Redwood hosted environment or within a Dedicated/private deployment if required for data controls. For initial evals we recommend hosted with dataset upload to a secured folder (we purge after 90 days by default) OR we can accept a hashed/anonymized dataset.

6) Timeline / next steps
- Please send a sample CSV and any security questionnaire (SOC2 / data retention requirements).
- I’ll loop Neha (applied ML) and Dylan (platform) to schedule the run and provisioning.
- Proposed kickoff: Wed 7/7 or Thu 7/8 morning PT — 30m to confirm dataset & priority prompts.

Attachments: sample template included (finbank_eval_dataset_sample.csv) — please replace with representative examples rather than synthetic ones.

Links: eval playbook & rubric: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cfinbank-evals

If you’re good with this plan, send the sample dataset + your security questionnaire and we’ll queue the run.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
